newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine parliament forgives AvtoZAZ debts.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine parliament forgives AvtoZAZ debts.

text.p: Ukraine's parliament forgave debts on Friday of the AvtoZAZ car manufacturer, removing an obstacle to a joint venture with U.S. carmaker General Motors and South Korea's Daewoo Group.

Apart from elimination of the 60 million hryvnia ($32.3 million) debt, the foreign companies are seeking a law guaranteeing tax breaks for the venture, which would involve upgrading the plant in the eastern city of Zaporizhya to build small- and mid-size cars.
Clinching the deal, which has no set deadline, would be a great success for Ukraine which has attracted only $1.6 billion in foreign investment since independence almost six years ago.
Parliament started its summer recess on Friday, with plans to reconvene temporarily at the end of August.
--Yuri Kulikov, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 244-9150 $1=1.8570 hryvnias ($ = 1.856 Ukrainian Hryvnias)
